description: Query an AT Protocol player's per-game achievement progress, completion showcase, and verified trophy breakdown.

main.description: Returns a player's Gamercard summary centered on per-game achievement appreciation and completion (with no global XP/gamerscore system or per-game achievement count cap), excluding unverified or publisher-revoked (`games.opengaming.revocation`) unlocks.

actor.description: Handle or DID of the player.

gamesPlayed.description: Number of distinct games in which the player has earned at least one verified achievement.

completedGames.description: Number of games in which the player has unlocked 100% of published achievements.

totalUnlocks.description: Total verified, non-revoked achievements unlocked across all games.

totalAchievements.description: Total achievements defined by this game (uncapped).

completionPercent.description: Floored integer completion percentage (`0..100`), reaching `100` strictly when `unlockedCount == totalAchievements`.

completed.description: True when the game defines at least one achievement and the player has unlocked all of them.

latestUnlockAt.description: Timestamp of the player's most recent verified achievement unlock in this game.
